description: Neb: SessionStart (arranque) y hooks opcionales, que se activan con NEB_HOOKS / NEB_PROJECT_HOOKS (ver hooks/README.md).

hooks.command: case ",$NEB_HOOKS,$NEB_PROJECT_HOOKS," in *,save-approved-plan,*) python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/neb-hook.py" save-approved-plan || python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/neb-hook.py" save-approved-plan ;; esac
case ",$NEB_HOOKS,$NEB_PROJECT_HOOKS," in *,usage-tracker,*) python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/neb-hook.py" usage-tracker || python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/neb-hook.py" usage-tracker ;; esac
case ",$NEB_HOOKS,$NEB_PROJECT_HOOKS," in *,logbook-sync,*) python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/neb-hook.py" logbook-sync || python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/neb-hook.py" logbook-sync ;; esac

case ",$NEB_HOOKS,$NEB_PROJECT_HOOKS," in *,notify-on-stop,*) python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/neb-hook.py" notify-on-stop || python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/neb-hook.py" notify-on-stop ;; esac
case ",$NEB_HOOKS,$NEB_PROJECT_HOOKS," in *,logbook-sync,*) python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/neb-hook.py" logbook-sync || python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/neb-hook.py" logbook-sync ;; esac
case ",$NEB_HOOKS,$NEB_PROJECT_HOOKS," in *,ops-capture,*) python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/neb-hook.py" ops-capture || python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/neb-hook.py" ops-capture ;; esac
case ",$NEB_HOOKS,$NEB_PROJECT_HOOKS," in *,logbook-sync,*) python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/neb-hook.py" logbook-sync || python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/neb-hook.py" logbook-sync ;; esac

case ",$NEB_HOOKS,$NEB_PROJECT_HOOKS," in *,preprocess-prompt,*) python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/neb-hook.py" preprocess-prompt || python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/neb-hook.py" preprocess-prompt ;; esac

case ",$NEB_HOOKS,$NEB_PROJECT_HOOKS," in *,notify-on-permission,*) python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/neb-hook.py" notify-on-permission || python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/neb-hook.py" notify-on-permission ;; esac
